intent_names.submit_to_eval_api: Submits code to the evaluation API with the shared evaluation key
intent_names.cloud_metadata: Queries the cloud metadata service, where machine credentials live
intent_names.registry_board: Uses the registry mailbox: folders on a package cache used as a shared message board
intent_names.hf_dataset_write: Writes to a Hugging Face dataset
intent_names.hf_read: Contacts Hugging Face (any request that is not a dataset commit or upload; it can still POST)
intent_names.shortener_chain: Follows a chain of link-shortener redirects
intent_names.kubernetes_token: Reads a Kubernetes service-account token or names the kube-system namespace: credential access inside the cluster, not an API call

tag_names.api_key_or_bearer: Attaches an API key or bearer token
tag_names.image_beacon: Loads a URL as an image (silent request, often a beacon)
tag_names.writes_to_page: Writes the result into the page
tag_names.reads_system_files: Reads system, process, network or environment info
tag_names.credential_search: Looks for credentials or cluster access
tag_names.mailbox_or_board_marker: Writes to a shared mailbox or board name
tag_names.self_replication_or_child_controller: Launches or replaces controllers or pods
tag_names.registry_or_cache_poisoning: Touches a package registry or cache
tag_names.flag_or_ctf_target: Refers to a challenge flag or known CVE
tag_names.remote_script_or_shortener: Loads code from a remote URL or a link-shortener chain
